tools.name: get_user
tools.description: Profile of one X user by handle. 1 credit.

tools.name: get_users
tools.description: Profiles of up to 100 X users by handle in one call. 1 credit per profile found.

tools.name: get_user_tweets
tools.description: Latest tweets of a user, newest first. 1 credit per tweet.

tools.name: get_followers
tools.description: Followers of a user. 0.1 credit per profile. Not every account tier can read this; a 403 is free.

tools.name: get_follower_ids
tools.description: Numeric ids of the followers of a user, no profiles. 0.02 credit per id. Same page as get_followers, so a page read there is a cache hit here. A 403 is free.

tools.name: get_following
tools.description: Accounts a user follows. 0.1 credit per profile. Not every account tier can read this; a 403 is free.

tools.name: search_tweets
tools.description: X advanced search. q takes the x.com operators. 1 credit per tweet or profile. product Latest is always available; Top may answer 403 (free).

tools.name: get_tweet
tools.description: One tweet by numeric id, with its author. 1 credit.

tools.name: get_tweets
tools.description: Up to 100 tweets by numeric id in one call. 1 credit per tweet found.

tools.name: get_thread
tools.description: A tweet with its thread and replies; the focal tweet comes first. 1 credit per tweet returned.

tools.name: get_replies
tools.description: Direct replies to a tweet, one page. 1 credit per reply.

tools.name: get_quotes
tools.description: Tweets that quote a tweet, newest first. 1 credit per tweet.

tools.name: get_retweeters
tools.description: Accounts that retweeted a tweet. 0.5 credit per profile. Not every account tier can read this; a 403 is free.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Credits left on this key and its rate limit. Free.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_thread · Public sink: get_user_tweets, search_tweets, get_tweet, get_tweets, get_thread, get_replies, get_quotes, get_retweeters.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_thread · Public sink: get_user_tweets, search_tweets, get_tweet, get_tweets, get_thread, get_replies, get_quotes, get_retweeters

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
